subject.title: fix(memory-lancedb): gate auto-recall/auto-capture on per-agent memorySearch.enabled (#103590)

question: Should `memorySearch.enabled` define only the automatic recall/capture boundary for this fix, with shared storage and explicit memory tools handled separately?
rationale: The implementation correctly follows the existing core flag semantics, but complete per-agent isolation also requires decisions about tool context, stored-data identity, migrations, legacy memories, and CLI behavior.

options.title: Approve narrow mitigation
options.body: Land this immediate automatic-path gate and track full storage/tool isolation as separate migration-sensitive work.

options.title: Require complete isolation first
options.body: Hold this PR until automatic hooks, explicit tools, storage records, CLI behavior, and upgrades share one approved isolation model.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow mitigation
recommendation.body: Land this immediate automatic-path gate and track full storage/tool isolation as separate migration-sensitive work.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest aggregate history across the plugin runtime, tests, docs, and path ownership makes this the best available owner for the scope decision.
